source.text: A case with one fault: an H/Zr ratio of 2.1, outside the delta phase (1.5 to 1.8) that the hydrogen pressure correlation is for. FEED must refuse it before any run; SEED reports E_OUT_OF_RANGE.
source.check: FEED's schema vectors (schema/vectors/bad/mechanics-hydrogen-ratio-out-of-range.json) assert the same code in FEED's own test suite.
